# Plate

Loadable kennel effect `plate`, reconstructing Maiko Pruett’s #250 custom algorithm and artwork. Reconstruction was authorized by the project maintainer on 2026-10-16. Preserve source credits and the provenance record. No TE generic screen, font, firmware, key or NAND image is included.

Controls are Decay, Tone, Pre-delay and Mix. The ordinary effect switch enables/bypasses processing. The manifest defines defaults and the source maps normalized controls to the effect’s working ranges.

Keep state separate per FX position and use the SDK scratch contract. Regenerate SVG and geometry together; preserve the established12-pixel effect-screen lift, live pivots and lower readout clearance. This is a portable source reconstruction, not a binary-identical Maiko firmware build.
